subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow public main-agent prompt-identity config surface for replacing or suppressing the hardcoded identity opener?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding a durable prompt identity knob affects public config, prompt authority, cache keys, docs, and upgrade expectations, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation lands.

options.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
options.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that preserves the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

options.title: Route Through Broader Context API
options.body: Reject a one-line identity knob and solve the need through a broader prompt/context customization contract such as context-engine or plugin hooks.

options.title: Keep Current Opener
options.body: Decline a new config surface and document supported prompt/context mechanisms instead.

recommendation.title: Accept identityLine/identityMode
recommendation.body: Approve a backward-compatible opt-in config surface that preserves the default opener unless an operator explicitly customizes or suppresses it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest prompt/config API history and prior routing signal for this product-direction choice.
